In place addition

grapes-plus-equals-grapes.Rd

x %+=% y adds y to x and stores the sum in x. %+=% binds more tightly than * and /, so x %+=% y/2 sets x to x + y and halves only the returned value. Write x %+=% (y/2) to add half of y.

Usage

e1 %+=% e2

Arguments

e1

first addend, replaced by the sum

e2

second addend

Value

the new value of e1, invisibly

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
add_QMOD.xts$VISUS_HI[pq(2022.3, 2023.4)] <- add_QMOD.xts$VISUS_HI[pq(2022.3, 2023.4)] +
  c(0.01, -0.04, rep(-0.025, 4))
add_QMOD.xts$VISUS_HI[pq(2022.3, 2023.4)] %+=% c(0.01, -0.04, rep(-0.025, 4)) # easier on the eye
}
